WS2 - PART 2 - Pooled Multi-Tenant Agent Platform Architecture (Pattern A: Pool)
Google Cloud — Centralized Multi-Tenant Governance & Control Plane
Pooled Memory Bank & Data (AlloyDB FORCE RLS)

text.tspan: WHO RUNS WHAT IN PATTERN A (POOL)
identity, ingress, 2 gateways, registry, rate limits, audit
ISV-operated: one shared stack for every tenant. Both gateways and the rate limiter
sit on every request, so their capacity follows request volume.
front end, ADK runtime, MCP servers, A2A agents, models
ISV-operated pool for the runtime, MCP and A2A; models are consumed as a service
(Gemini, 3P LLMs). One pool, so capacity follows total turns across tenants.
sessions (Valkey) + Memory Bank & Data (AlloyDB FORCE RLS)
ISV-operated, two shared stores. A tenant is a {tenant}:{user} key and a row filter
Tenant users and IdPs (left) are not a plane. Enterprise APIs (right) lead to systems outside the
platform; the ISV does not run them.
